text: Hello everyone, welcome to my class.Today we are going to talk about 青团 for the Qingming Festival.By the end of the lesson, you are expected to grasp the gist of the passage and know about the origin and the making of 青团.Moreover, you are expected to be able to introduce 青团 in a given context in proper words logically.Before class, please get your textbook and worksheet ready.In the past June, we enjoyed the sweetness of 粽子 for the Dragon Boat Festival and the aroma of mooncake in September.Food is an important element that defines our culture.Most of our traditional festivals are associated with a particular kind of food.Now, try to match the following food with its relevant festival and legendary person.You'll have 10 seconds.Let's see if you got them right.饺子 is traditionally made and served on the eve of the Lunar New Year.It's said that 饺子 was invented by great Chinese medicine doctor Zhang Zhongjing in ancient time, who cured people's ear diseases with mutton soup and ear-shaped dumplings in it, which is similar to today's 饺子 in shape.Later on, 饺子 stands for health and a better life.My students will share the legend of the next three traditional treats with you.元宵 is a white rice ball with sweet fillings, usually enjoyed on the night of the Lantern Festival.According to the legend, 元宵 was the name of a female servant in the Imperial Palace in Han Dynasty, who hadn't seen her families for a long time.Luckily, she finally got reunited with her family with the help of the official 东方朔.No wonder 元宵 means union with families and happiness.元宵 used boat with 粽子 to the river and threw 粽子 into the river to help protect the body of the patriotic poet 屈原 from being eaten by fish.粽子 is not only a kind of food, but conveys people's respect for patriots.月糕 is usually shared among families on the night of the Mid-Autumn Festival while the whole family enjoys the full moon.Round mooncakes and full moon symbolize the union of the family, which is valued in Chinese culture.Among many legends about mooncake, one of the most well-known is that Zhu Yuanzhang planned a coup d'etat against the violent rulers of Yuan dynasty, which was about to take place on the 15th day of the 8th lunar month.He hid a secret message in mooncake and succeeded in overthrowing Yuan rulers.Since then, mooncakes are more popular among people.Today, we will learn about another kind of traditional food 青团.青团 is usually served cold at the Qingming Festival.I bet you have all tried it before.Do you like traditional 青团 with sweet feelings?My students share their experience here.Yes, I like sweet 青团.It tastes like sticky ice lollies, especially when just taken out from the fridge.Yes, I like sweet 青团, but I prefer 青团 with salty feelings, which has more varieties in flavor.They both like 青团 despite their different preference for flavor.Apart from its taste, we can know more about 青团 from this passage.What do you expect to know about 青团 from the passage?Let's listen to what my students want to know.I want to know why people eat 青团 at the Qingming Festival.What do people use to make 青团?Do many people like 青团?After all, 青团 isn't common homemade dishes.These may be the topics you want to read about in the passage.And now you have two minutes to scheme the passage and confirm your prediction.青团 青团 青团 青团 Now, let's take a look together.青团 is traditional, but that doesn't mean it is outdated.These phrases, social media hit, and are waiting to buy in paragraph 1 and 2 help you to see how people like it.These two paragraphs clearly show people's enthusiasm about 青团, whether they are young or old.Besides, 青团 isn't originally connected to the Qingming Festival.The custom gradually comes to its present form as time goes by.We can clearly find the legend of 青团 in paragraph 3.The word legend gives us a hint.If you want to learn to make 青团 on your own, paragraph 4 is really helpful.Well, you can find all you need to make 青团.In addition to all these above, you will also get to know some people who protect the tradition and insist in passing it down in paragraph 5.Thanks to these people, we still can enjoy 青团 today.But the passage doesn't focus on the changing flavor of 青团.Now, let's explore more details about 青团.You have one minute to read through paragraph 1 and 2.Find more evidence to prove people like 青团 and what 青团 looks like.青团 青团 青团 Besides the two phrases just mentioned, Queue up for 青团 and are definitely worth the long wait in paragraph 2 show that people are enthusiastic about 青团.青团 is a green rice ball with either sweet or salty feelings.Here we notice 青团 isn't outdated.When society develops fast, On the contrary, it keeps up with times and even takes off.From the highlighted sentences, What can you infer about link between tradition and new media?Here is my student understanding.New media serves to spread tradition and strengthen people's enthusiasm for it.At the same time, the culture of eating 青团 has been wholly passed down and integrated into new life pattern.You may have your own idea.Then why is some tradition carried forward while others disappear or get unknown?Such as the 寒食 festival in paragraph 3.Let's read paragraph 3 to find the reason.You have one minute and these four questions will help you sort out information.青团 青团 As we have read, people started to eat 青团 2000 years ago from the Zhou dynasty.People used to eat it one or two days before the Qingming festival.And now, people eat it during the Qingming festival and during ancestral rituals.As for why people eat 青团 cold.It is because in the past, people didn't use fire during the 寒食 festival to remember the virtuous officer 戒子推 who died in the fire.Though the 寒食 festival is no longer observed by people nowadays, the tradition of eating 青团 cold has been preserved.And now, 青团 is served to cold during the Qingming festival in memory of our late families.But here I have another doubt.Why do people honor 戒子推 instead of others?We know from the paragraph, he was a virtuous officer, and I have found more.戒子推 was a representative of Confucian thought.He was devoted to the emperor and put forward constructive suggestions, but never asked for reward.His integrity, loyalty, and devotion was thought of as a model for the following scholar bureaucrats, and therefore enjoined a high reputation, and was honored at the 寒食 festival after his death.So in a sense, 青团 is not only traditional food, but a vehicle of people's admiration for great virtue, and a reminder of our lost families, therefore arousing our emotional resonance deep down in our heart.Now that 青团 boasts such a long history, is the flavor we enjoy today the same as it was thousands of years ago?Now let's proceed to read paragraph 4.Find what ingredients are used to make 青团, and what are they used for.Filling the form, you have one minute.We can easily locate glutinous rice flour is for the sticky skin of the rice balls, and the mugwort is used to color the screen green.Sweet green bean or red bean paste is used to color the screen green.Sweet green bean or red bean paste is for the traditional flavors, and the salted egg yolk or pork fillings is for the non-traditional flavors.While reading, I find the first sentence shows that the technique remains almost the same.So I believe the present flavor of 青团 is quite close to that in the past.The fifth sentence states 杏花楼 has made changes in the recipe, and introduced a new taste.One states the tradition of making 青团 is unchanged, but the other informs us that the tradition has been innovated.Do you think the two statements contradict each other?I would like to share my student's idea with you.Take 青团 for an example.Innovation not only enriches its variety in flavor, but also helps attract many young people.Innovation doesn't mean abandoning tradition, but improving tradition to fit it into modern life.Also, tradition doesn't mean no change, but means preserving the nuclear part and development with.Yes, thanks to innovation, people can have more choices about 青团 and other things.But some people may have different preferences.Now let's read paragraph 5 and have a look at what Granny Wang and Aunt Jo have in common.You have one minute.You noticed they have a lot in common.They both are fans of traditional 青团 and prefer traditional flavors.Besides, they both make their own 青团 instead of buying them.And the third, they both try to pass down the tradition in their own way.Granny Wang teaches her daughter how to make 青团.Aunt Jo has made 青团 for many years.Then think about what they stand for.Again, here is my student's understanding.I think they stand for tradition.And they are representatives of people who stick to tradition and pass it down from one generation to another.It is because of people like Granny Wang and Aunt Jo that we can enjoy traditional things in a new era.Yes, we should thank such grannies and aunties for passing down such precious traditions to us young people.Now we've finished reading the whole passage.Let's look back on the passage and dig deep.From the passage, we not only know many facts about 青团.This is, people still love traditional 青团.And we also know the story about 青团 and how it is made.And we get to know people like Granny Wang and Aunt Jo who stick to tradition.Here we have found an underlying structure in the passage.From my perspective, the passage answers the question why the tradition of eating 青团 hasn't been lost in time, but has regained the popularity instead.And the passage gives us well-grounded reasons.Inheritors of tradition, the people, have the wellness to pass it down.The making of 青团 combines traditional and innovative technique, which enriches its flavor.青团 arouses people's emotional resonance and is closely associated with a special ritual in life.So the tradition of eating 青团 has been well-preserved, passed down, and warmly greeted by young people.To put it in a broad sense, our valuable cultural tradition should be treasured and can be properly innovated, hence regaining its vigor in the new era.Just now we have got a clear picture of the past and the present of 青团.Now suppose you work as a guide as the food and beverage exhibition, where many foreign visitors are curious about 青团.Now you are responsible to introduce 青团 to them.Prepare what you want to say in two minutes.青团 青团 青团 青团 青团 青团 Here is my student's presentation.青团 is a green rice ball with either sweet or salty fillings.Traditionally, the sticky green skin is made of glutinous rice flour and colored green with mugwort.Normally, sweet green bean and red bean paste is used as fillings and later to cater to young people's taste.Producers innovate the recipe and salty fillings have been employed.The tradition of eating 青团 dates back to about 2000 years ago.Later, ancient people ate a code to honor the virtuous official 介子推 in the Warring States period, who died tragically in a fire.Now, people usually enjoy this traditional snack code at the 青鸣 Festival in memory of their late families.It's a great miracle that the tradition of making and eating 青团 has been preserved well and passed down.I think it's because 青团 has been an important part of life.As my student says, it's a miracle that traditional food like 青团 can be enjoyed today.In fact, there is much traditional food still served on our table.Next week, some exchange students are coming to your school to learn about Chinese culture and you are supposed to introduce another kind of traditional food to them.Refer to materials available and prepare for your speech.Chinese people boast a diversified food culture.After class, explore more legends of traditional food, such as 辣巴抗冶, 群羊cake, etc., and make a poster.That's all for today.Bye bye.
